# Accepted public API breaks for v0.57.0 (package gotreesitter).
#
# The apidiff job in .github/workflows/ci.yml compares the root package with the
# latest stable tag and fails on every incompatible change that this file does
# not list. An entry has three fields separated by single TAB characters:
#
#   <exact apidiff line><TAB><PR><TAB><upgrade note>
#
# The first field must equal one line of `apidiff -incompatible` output
# (whole-line match; no patterns). The job reports an entry that apidiff no
# longer reports as stale. A removal PR appends its own entries. Delete this
# file when v0.57.0 is tagged, because the baseline then moves to that tag.
#
# Removals outside package gotreesitter are not visible to apidiff. They are
# recorded in comments for the v0.57.0 upgrade notes.
#
# grammars facade (P09): the generator no longer mirrors these names from
# grammars/runtime. Import github.com/odvcencio/gotreesitter/grammars/runtime
# and use grammarruntime.<Name> instead.
#   <Lang>ExternalScanner type aliases, 118 in all (for example
#     grammars.PythonExternalScanner)
#   RegisterCaddySupport, RegisterDisassemblySupport, RegisterNimSupport
#   DecodeAndCertifyLanguageBlob, NewGenericTokenSourceOrEOF
#   ExternalScannerSpecs (deleted from grammars/runtime as well; nothing used it)
# Kept on the facade: RegisterExternalScanner, LookupExternalScanner,
# SetEmbeddedLanguageCacheLimit and the other documented loader functions.
#
- ExternalVMInstr: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOp: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpAdvance: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpEmit: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpFail: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead

- ExternalVMOpIfRuneEq: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead

- ExternalVMOpJump: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpMarkEnd: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpRequireStateEq: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpRequireValid: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMOpSetState: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
- ExternalVMProgram: removed	P09	no replacement; write a Go gotreesitter.ExternalScanner instead
